parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Canonical action UUID; mutation retries reuse this key. Reads also require a UUID at the machine transport boundary.

parameters.name: X-Kallfi-Workspace-ID
parameters.description: Untrusted explicit workspace UUID. Omitted selects Personal. Workspace commands require current membership, role, surface and grant; explicit denied selection never falls back. Account-owned commands reject a nonpersonal selected workspace. One Account surface key spans currently authorized workspaces; selecting a workspace never issues another key.
